_rules.fail_closed: A failed gate stops the workstream. Thresholds MUST NOT be lowered to obtain a pass.
_rules.evidence_required: Every quantitative claim cites a source with a date, a path:line location, or a reproducible command.

purpose: Determine whether the optimisation and verification machinery of the host system transfers to industrial planning problems, and package a verifiable public artefact.

decisions.decision: No external investment and no return-on-investment defence.
Business Source Licence 1.1 with an Additional Use Grant, paired with a specification under Apache-2.0.
Elaborate mathematical machinery is permitted in this programme and prohibited on the host production tree. Re-import requires evidence and a proposal.
Logistics is the active workstream. Electronic design automation is suspended and unstaffed.
The event model is event-agnostic. Named events MUST NOT appear in decision logic.
Data acquisition budget is zero. Only openly licensed data is used.
Primary objective is professional reputation and a verifiable public artefact. Revenue is a secondary consequence.
Schedule is 35 working days. The 90-day plan is withdrawn. Superseded by D-18, which re-baselines the schedule to five to seven working days.
The event model is layered, not six-dimensional: six physical axes plus propagation (4), information (2), institutions (3) and four catalyst domains with twelve indices.

Cascades are modelled as a branching process with k_eff = fanout x susceptibility x (1 + catalyst pressure), plus a percolation check on the largest connected component. Limits are stated: synthetic calibration only.
Four structural catalysts are first-class: geoeconomic fragmentation, workforce volatility, credit and liquidity, cyber insecurity. Each adds gate codes rather than new narrative vocabulary.
All gate and planner decisions use integer micro-units and integer minutes, reusing ADR-001 of the host engine. Floating point is confined to transport and reporting.

Two implementations exist: the Python reference and a dependency-free Rust core. Conformance is proved by replaying exported instances; 300 of 300 agree. Release hashes are produced on the integer CPU path, never in a shader.
Gate B4 is decided by a paired bootstrap with a zero guard band and a pre-registered ladder that raises coupling without lowering the bar. Both limbs must be reported even when only one is met.

Licence change date is two years from first public release. Two years is shorter than the BUSL-1.1 maximum of four, so it is compliant and reaches open source sooner. This supersedes the four-year answer for open decision 1.
If gate B4 is non-separating, the artefact may be released as a plan auditor with reduced scope, provided SW-08 states the limitation in its first paragraph.
No external domain reviewer is appointed. Limitations are recorded in SW-03, SW-11 and SW-12 instead of being hidden.
The schedule is re-baselined to five to seven working days. The 35-day plan is withdrawn as unrepresentative of the work; this supersedes D-8.
A physical layer is adopted only when it changes a decision, and its constants live in config/physics.json. Fields that do not change a decision stay in the survey, not in the code.
The research tree is English and code only, with no CJK characters, and contains no if/elif dispatch: rules live in tables. Both rules are enforced by tests, not by review.

The product name is Switchyard. Prior art was checked before adoption: the name is already used by an unrelated educational networking framework on the Python Package Index, so a Python distribution would need a suffix.

Ambient weather data is open reanalysis only: the free, keyless Open-Meteo archive API serving ERA5, frozen as a July 1991-2020 climatology in config/weather_regions.json. A live forecast ingest is out of scope until a consumer needs one.

Separation precedes new work. From 2026-10-23 this tree is a standalone repository: the copy held inside the host tree is extracted, the guard modules travel with it, and nothing here is a worktree of the host. The three candidate projects are deferred. Re-entry into the host system, and the repair of pain points in it, are recorded directions rather than scheduled work, and re-entry happens as a dependency or as a ported mechanism with tests, never by copying files into the host tree.

The product name is switchyard-logistics, by the owner's instruction on 2026-10-23; D-21 is superseded. The distribution name in pyproject.toml already carried the qualifier because `switchyard` is taken on the Python Package Index. The registry id SW-xx, the import package `switchyard` and the Rust binary `switchyard-core` are identifiers and are unchanged, so no document is renumbered and no import moves.

goal.success_definition: An independent party reproduces the same release hash on a machine without a graphics processor and without credentials, and explains the verdict within five minutes.
not_goal: become an electronic design automation vendor
introduce elaborate machinery into the production pipeline

licensing.strategy: Source-available reference implementation with a freely licensed specification.
licensing.posture: Source is public; production use is free for individuals and small organisations; each release becomes open source after a published date. The software MUST NOT be described as open source while the Business Source Licence applies.

components.name: gate-spec
components.what: Vocabulary, gate codes, unsafe control actions, dispatch release schema. Documents only.
components.why: A specification must be freely available to be cited and independently implemented.

components.name: gate-ref

production_use_free_for: companies with annual revenue below USD 5M and fewer than 100 employees
excluded: offering this software as a competing managed or hosted service

components.why: The implementation is the only component with commercial value, and it becomes open source on a fixed calendar.
components.change_date_basis: BUSL-1.1 converts on the Change Date or the fourth anniversary of first public distribution, whichever comes first; a later date is inert. Four years is the maximum, not a preference.
components.per_version_clock: Each released version starts its own four-year clock, so the current version is always protected without amending the licence.
commitments: No retroactive extension of a published Change Date
No restriction added to the Additional Use Grant for a published version
components.no_conversion_fallback: PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 if a version must never convert

alternatives_considered.name: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0
alternatives_considered.advantage: Prepared legal text; free below 100 people and USD 1M revenue.
alternatives_considered.limitation: Fixed threshold with no change date; never becomes open source.

alternatives_considered.name: PolyForm Shield
alternatives_considered.limitation: Reads as hostile to the intended audience.

alternatives_considered.name: AGPL-3.0
alternatives_considered.limitation: Rejected by infrastructure buyers; incompatible with a free tier for small users.

licensing.threshold_policy: Threshold values are data and are changed only in this file. Revenue and headcount are used because both are verifiable; fleet size is not.

clean_room_stance.legal_fact: Copyright protects expression, not idea or behaviour. An independent implementation written from the published specification does not infringe.
therefore: retain the operational advantage in data, scenario packs, and integration
price the commercial licence below the cost of an independent reimplementation
protect the name through trademark policy rather than the idea through licence terms
clean_room_stance.patent: The commercial licence carries a patent grant with a retaliation clause, used only for a genuinely novel mechanism.

never: publish customer data or purchased data
claim that a passing verdict establishes legal or regulatory safety
describe a Business Source Licence release as open source

event_agnostic.invariant: The gate decides from state and constraints. Event names MUST NOT appear in decision logic.

damage_patterns.detect: time at node above node 95th percentile

damage_patterns.name: Thermal drift
damage_patterns.detect: rate of change above available cooling capacity

damage_patterns.name: Broken handoff

damage_patterns.name: Stale decision

unsafe_control_actions.action: release with slack below maximum handoff time
accept a reroute that removes temperature monitoring
consolidate two temperature classes in one container
depart on data older than the freshness limit
accept an excursion without documented disposition
release when receiving door is unconfirmed
depend on a single mode with an open blocking condition
accept a cost reduction without recomputing excursion
release without a per-leg accountable party

banned_in_logic: port, canal, or country names as branch conditions

import_back_policy.rule: Any mechanism from this programme re-enters production only through three steps: a research proposal, owner approval, and an implementation with tests.
import_back_policy.why: Decision D-3: elaborate machinery degrades the production path.
import_back_policy.evidence_required: Measured comparison against the current implementation. An assertion that the new approach is preferable is not evidence.

b4_measurement.excursion_limb: met at intensities 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0; CI lower bounds 25.0 to 27.1 percent
b4_measurement.unsafe_action_limb: not met; point estimate 15.3 to 16.1 pp, CI lower bounds 13.0 to 13.8
b4_measurement.claim_allowed: fewer excursion minutes with a positive lower bound
b4_measurement.claim_forbidden: 15 percentage points fewer unsafe control actions

open_owner_decisions.question: Business Source Licence change date: four years or two years?
open_owner_decisions.resolution: Two years, per D-15. Four years remains the legal maximum, not the chosen value.

open_owner_decisions.question: May a non-separating result at gate B4 be released as a plan auditor?
open_owner_decisions.resolution: Yes, per D-16, with the limitation stated in SW-08. In this run the gate separates, so the fallback is unused.

open_owner_decisions.question: What is the product name? The artefact is referred to by registry id SW until the owner decides.
open_owner_decisions.resolution: Switchyard, chosen by the owner on 2026-10-23 and recorded here as the product name. The registry id SW-xx stays as the document and gate identifier, so no document has to be renumbered. Prior art checked the same day: the name is used by an unrelated educational networking framework published on the Python Package Index (switchyard 1.0.1, GPLv3) and by a retired integration product. Both are different fields, so the name is usable as a product name; it is NOT usable as a Python distribution name, which must carry a suffix (for example switchyard-logistics) if anything is ever published.

resolved_owner_decisions.was: approve installation of an electronic design automation toolchain?

resolved_owner_decisions.question: Business Source Licence change date
resolved_owner_decisions.answer: Two years (D-15); four years is the legal maximum, not the chosen value
resolved_owner_decisions.rationale: Recorded here to match the decision log: the change date is two years from publication, and the licence text converts at that anniversary. The earlier entry in this file said four years, which contradicted D-15 and has been corrected.

resolved_owner_decisions.question: Which ambient weather data may the research programme use?
resolved_owner_decisions.answer: Free open reanalysis only: Open-Meteo archive API (ERA5), keyless, no account
resolved_owner_decisions.rationale: Keeps the data budget at zero as decided (D-02) and makes every number checkable by a reader. The profile table is a frozen July 1991-2020 climatology committed as config/weather_regions.json, with attribution inside the file because the licence is CC BY 4.0. A live forecast ingest, if ever wanted, is the same seam with a fresher snapshot.

forbidden_claims.why: The phrase asserts a specific comparator and rounding. The measured point estimate is larger, but the comparison basis and the rounding differ, so the phrase overstates what the report supports.

future_projects._doc: Ideas recorded for later. None is started, and no name here is a decision.
future_projects.family: Switchyard is the first of four planned projects. The other three and the mass-market check are in _system/FUTURE_PROJECTS.md.

separation.task: Move  out of the host tree into its own repository with its own licence, so nothing in it depends on the host system.

candidates.subject: Graph and causal invariants: cycle and paradox detection, max-flow min-cut bottleneck, critical path with slack.
candidates.exists_today: Only max-flow with a min-cut certificate (src/switchyard/graph.py, 168 lines). Cycle detection and critical path are not written.
candidates.note: The crates.io name is taken, so a Rust crate needs a suffix.

candidates.subject: Bit-exact fixed-point state machine with rule tables and replay hashes.
candidates.exists_today: Substantial: integer micro-units, a seeded PRNG with stream splitting, canonical JSON and content hashing, plus a dependency-free Rust replay core.
candidates.note: Closest to shippable of the three.

candidates.subject: Betti-1 cycle detection over Vietoris-Rips complexes for anomaly detection.
candidates.exists_today: Nothing. No simplicial, homology, or persistence code exists in the tree.

future_projects.mass_market_note: The three candidates address niche but high-stakes pain. The pain that most developers report is different: review load and low-quality generated code, slow pipelines, unbounded technical debt, and cloud or token cost. See _system/FUTURE_PROJECTS.md section 4.
